answer: Force every new identity to earn standing through a sequential chain of useful work, where each task's input depends on the output of the one before, so the work cannot be split across a thousand clones at once. A farm wanting a meadow of fake agents would need a thousand chains running in series, each taking days, while one honest agent finishes one chain and finds a haven of trust. The tide of time becomes the cost, and no parallel compute can rush a sequence that moves one step at a time.
